epics.title: Safe tango knowledge track (no MuseScore corpus risk)
epics.goal: Curate abstract tango music-theory knowledge (sentence/phrase shape, progression families, rhythm archetypes) from legally safe sources only, then optionally wire into Lab behind generation_options default-off. Product is likely forever free — zero appetite for MuseScore.com / ML-training / community-score risk.
epics.notes: Policy: docs/research/KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE_POLICY.md. Roadmap table: docs/product/PROJECT_PLAN.md §3c (K1–K5). Forbidden: MuseScore.com bulk/Pro download as corpus; treating community uploads as PD; ML training on third-party scores; committing copyrighted MusicXML. Allowed: repo research, published musicology paraphrases, founder abstract notes, verified PD/CC0 metadata + abstract stats, test fixtures. Prefer extend ENGINE_KNOWLEDGE_REGISTRY + lab_catalog over parallel engines.
